slides.heading: Rearrange Linked List
slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Very Hard · Linked Lists
slides.narration: Let's solve Rearrange Linked List, a very hard linked lists problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: Stable partition around k: nodes < k, then == k, then > k.
slides.narration: Here's the problem. Stable partition around k: nodes under k, then equals equals k, then over k. Returns new head.

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: Build three separate lists for less, equal and greater, then join them.
slides.narration: Build three separate lists for less, equal and greater, then join them.

slides.heading: Brute force vs optimal
bullets: Copy values into arrays → O(n) space
Three dummy lists → O(n), O(1) space
slides.narration: Three dummy-headed lists collect nodes in order, then concatenate, linear time and constant space.

slides.heading: Approach
bullets: 1. Walk the list appending to the right partition
slides.narration: Step by step. First, walk the list appending to the right partition. Second, keep heads and tails. Third, connect the non-empty lists.

slides.heading: Worked example
slides.caption: Partition around k, keeping order
slides.narration: Rearrange so values less than 3 come first, then equal, then greater, keeping relative order.

slides.heading: Worked example
slides.caption: Three tail-appended lists
slides.narration: Walk once, appending each node to one of three lists.

slides.heading: Worked example
slides.caption: Concatenate
slides.narration: Join the three lists, carefully handling empty ones.

slides.heading: Java solution
slides.narration: We append each node to low, equal or high, terminate high, link equal to high, and low to equal or high if equal is empty.

slides.heading: Complexity
slides.narration: Time is O of n. Space is constant.

slides.heading: Edge cases & pitfalls
slides.narration: Terminate the high list with null, and skip empty partitions when linking.

slides.heading: Recap
bullets: Build three separate lists for less, equal and greater, then join them.
slides.narration: To recap Rearrange Linked List: Build three separate lists for less, equal and greater, then join them. Try re-implementing it from scratch without looking.
